CHICKENS — Ron Ridge

Source collection: The Spectrum Show, chickens.zip.
The supplied Z80 snapshot, TAP and TZX are stored without changes.
The 109-line BASIC listing was decoded from the TZX with the ZX-UX ROM LLIST tool.

Original source checksums (SHA-256):
chickens.z80  2fd6a03fcd90af0a4be6d083c32d1ce1cd4eb3b9f0cfb39bbe8f7bc4ff90dc65
chickens.tap  8211e4d482fbd2335ea24197f07f1cf237a6791d678d520a452762b04b45703b
chickens.tzx  05587e5e1873f933b8d1ed013bb877e627ed84df162b9967a244f780ff62795e

Fuse 1.6.0 ran the original Z80 snapshot in 48K mode. We followed the
on-screen start prompt, entered difficulty 10 and level 6, and pressed
6, 5 and 8 during play. The two captured frames show live gameplay
before and after input, including a changed chick position and timer.
These frames do not show a completed rescue or a full round.
No native game binary was built.
